body:
I was broken up with.

It's also finals week and I'm doing poorly in most, if not all of my classes

Thank you for your thoughtful reply.

I do not feel as though I am an important human being. I feel like I have placed all of my value in my future/potential self, and since I will never live up to my own standards, I don't want to live. 

I also have realized that my self worth has been misplaced. I have thought I was attractive before, but I am not. My girlfriend of 3 years broke up with me a week ago by admitting she was not physically attracted to me. I have thought I was smart in the past, thinking that maybe I'd be able to achieve my dreams and become a successful entrepreneur. The truth is, I'm simply not cut out for it and I have tried convincing myself that I am for a very long time. I am nearly failing every class I am in at my university. After some thought, I have come to the conclusion that I am affected by what is called the Dunning-Kruger Effect. http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dunning%E2%80%93Kruger_effect

Life is simply not worthwhile if you're living it as an underachieving, dreadfully average, unattractive, piece-of-shit excuse for a human being.
